body.condition: For every finite \(g\in\mathcal G\), every \(u\in\{g,\ldots,T\}\), and every \(c\in\mathcal C_u^{\mathrm{OVS}}\), the conditional untreated eligibility gap for cohort \(g\) at period \(u\) equals the corresponding gap for cohort \(c\): \[E_Q[\Delta Y_u(\infty,1)\mid G=g,S=1,X]-E_Q[\Delta Y_u(\infty,0)\mid G=g,S=0,X]=E_Q[\Delta Y_u(\infty,1)\mid G=c,S=1,X]-E_Q[\Delta Y_u(\infty,0)\mid G=c,S=0,X]\] almost surely.

standard.name: OVS global period-by-period covariate-conditional DDD parallel trends
